description: This file defines the 'OrderSet' class, which represents a grouping of orders into a set for decision support in the OpenMRS healthcare system. It includes properties such as order set ID, operator, category, and a list of members, along with methods for managing these properties.

classes.name: OrderSet
classes.description: Represents a collection of orders, allowing grouping and decision support capabilities, with properties and methods to manage order set attributes and membership.

methods.name: getOrderSetId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the order set.

methods.name: setOrderSetId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the order set.

methods.name: getOperator
methods.description: Returns the operator used for restrictions within this order set.

methods.name: setOperator
methods.description: Sets the operator used for restrictions within this order set.

methods.name: getOrderSetMembers
methods.description: Returns the list of order set members, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: setOrderSetMembers
methods.description: Sets the list of order set members.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the concept category associated with the order set.

methods.name: setCategory
methods.description: Sets the concept category for the order set.

methods.name: addOrderSetMember
methods.description: Adds an order set member at a specified position, or at the end if position is null.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the order set, as per BaseClass.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the identifier of the order set, as per BaseClass.

methods.name: getUnRetiredOrderSetMembers
methods.description: Retrieves order set members that are not marked as retired.

methods.name: removeOrderSetMember
methods.description: Removes a specified order set member from the list and clears its association.

methods.name: retireOrderSetMember
methods.description: Marks a specified order set member as retired.
